review: Updated frozen-candidate viewport evidence: independent visual review part 2
method: Each of the six supplied original PNGs was opened individually with view_image.
result: No visual blocker observed in the supplied updated captures.
verifiedVisible: Candidate date and the grey-dot collection status with complete Europe/Berlin are fully visible in all four narrow dark viewport captures.
In the reopened/submitted narrow captures, the complete date/status/time-zone metadata sits above the fixed submitted-status footer.
The two mobile light invitation captures preserve the full cross-day time summary, both highlighted day segments, and existing reply controls.
limits: Narrow viewport captures are scrolled to reveal the metadata; top navigation is partly outside the frame. This does not establish an unscrolled first-screen layout.

Mobile invitation captures are full-page images with fixed reply controls over the content at the capture position. Portions of body or roster are covered in the capture; all content is not claimed to be simultaneously visible.
Review is limited to six supplied changed captures. No browser interaction, phone operation, deployment, repository changes, independent API verification, or Calendar integrity check was performed.

images.observation: Mobile light invitation: title, location, complete Europe/Berlin, cross-day time summary, both highlighted day segments, and reply controls are readable. Existing invitation presentation remains distinct.

Narrow 320 px / 20 px dark anonymous viewport: complete title and wrapped location, both candidate-date lines, grey status dot, Collecting availability, and complete Europe/Berlin are visible. Top navigation is partly outside the scrolled viewport.

Narrow 320 px / 20 px dark reopened viewport: both date lines and complete grey status/time-zone caption are visibly above the fixed submitted-status footer; title and location wrap without collision.

Mobile light invitation: complete cross-day time summary, both highlighted day segments, complete Europe/Berlin, and reply controls are readable. Fixed controls overlap a portion of the full-page roster capture.

Narrow 320 px / 20 px dark anonymous viewport: both date lines and complete grey status/time-zone caption are readable within the visible viewport; long title and location wrap. Top navigation is partly outside the scrolled viewport.
Narrow 320 px / 20 px dark submitted viewport: both date lines and complete Collecting availability / Europe/Berlin caption are fully visible above the fixed submitted-status footer.
